text: つくえの　うえに　あるのは　わしが　つくった　ポケモンずかん！

structure.jp: つくえの　うえに　あるのは

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns it into 'the thing that...'. あるのは = 'the thing that is (there)'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わしが　つくった　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: The verb part before the noun describes it. わしがつくったポケモンずかん = 'the Pokédex I made'.
